hero.headline: Vercel, deliver hyper-relevant experiences at the speed of your Edge.
hero.subhead: Your platform empowers the world's fastest web experiences. Now, ensure your own marketing adapts with the same agility, delivering personalized content to every enterprise target.
hero.ctaSecondary: Explore the Prismic for Next.js docs

valueProps.title: Marketer-owned LP iteration
valueProps.body: Empower your marketing teams to launch, test, and iterate on landing pages independently, without needing constant developer cycles. Prismic's visual editor and Slice Machine integrate seamlessly with your Next.js components.

valueProps.title: Dynamic content at the Edge
valueProps.body: Leverage Prismic's global CDN and Prismic Agents to serve personalized content variations instantly, ensuring every visitor sees the most relevant message, just as your customers expect from Vercel.

valueProps.title: Scale ABM with precision
valueProps.body: Move beyond static pages. Automatically adapt your site's messaging, CTAs, and even imagery based on IP detection, firmographic data, or referral source, turning every visit into a tailored conversation.

trustBar.headline: Trusted by leading enterprise and developer-focused platforms.

fitSection.headline: Built for the Next.js ecosystem you champion.
fitSection.body: You've set the standard for modern web development with Next.js and the Edge. Prismic is designed from the ground up to complement this architecture, providing a headless CMS and intelligent agents that extend your existing stack, not replace it. We speak your language, integrate with your workflows, and amplify your team's output.
fitBullets: Native Next.js integration for SSR, SSG, and ISR.
Component-driven development with Slices, mapping directly to your React components.
Edge-native content delivery ensuring personalized content is served with minimal latency.

closingCta.headline: Transform your marketing site into a dynamic growth engine.
closingCta.body: Stop leaving enterprise opportunities on the table due to static content. Prismic Agents enable your team to deliver tailored experiences at scale, driving higher engagement and conversion. See how quickly you can launch your first ABM-powered page.

growthBrief.opportunityTitle: Unlock significant enterprise pipeline by activating dynamic, personalized ABM on vercel.com.

rationaleBlocks.title: The ABM Gap on Vercel.com
bullets: Vercel's own marketing site shows **missed personalization opportunities** for diverse personas (e.g., enterprise vs. startup developers).
Static content on key landing pages means high-value **enterprise targets** receive generic messaging, increasing friction.
This limits the ability to **tailor value propositions** and CTAs based on firmographic data or known intent.

rationaleBlocks.title: Prismic Agents as the Solution
bullets: Prismic's **ABM Agent** enables dynamic content delivery, allowing Vercel to serve hyper-personalized LPs to identified accounts.
Leverage **reverse-IP lookup** and CRM data to automatically adapt hero sections, value props, and case studies for specific visitors.
Empower marketing to **iterate on LPs rapidly** without developer dependency, using a Next.js-native headless CMS.

rationaleBlocks.title: Opportunity Sizing
bullets: Assuming Vercel targets **500 enterprise accounts** annually, with a 1% conversion rate to MQL on generic LPs.
Improving this to a **3% conversion rate** with personalized ABM could yield 10 additional MQLs monthly.
At a **10% MQL-to-Opportunity** conversion and a €100k average ACV, this translates to roughly **€50,000 in new pipeline value per month**.

growthBrief.quickWin: Implement Prismic's ABM Agent to dynamically personalize the vercel.com homepage hero section and a key enterprise solutions page for a target list of 50 high-value accounts. A/B test the personalized versions against the generic pages, measuring **click-through rates** to demo requests and **time on page** for the target audience within the first 30 days. Track the **number of qualified leads** generated from the personalized pages compared to the control group.
